record_scope_reconstruction: December1 episode throttles commercial truck approach at VyšnéNemecké–Uzhhorod, with cargo exemptions and continued limited throughput. It is not a passenger closure or a whole Slovakia–Ukraine frontier restriction.

source_checks.finding: STVR December1 reports15:00 UNAS blockade, four ordinary trucks/hour and aid/military/live-animal/fuel/fresh-food exceptions; customs processing continued.
Named VyšnéNemecké(TIR) Slovak truck checkpoint; not Uzhhorod passenger/rail facility. Actual protesters on road approach not independently located.
